title: SWING11_S4P_STRATEGY_DEVELOPMENT_PROTOCOL_V1
decision: Prospectively approve the SWING11 S4 practical strategy-development design recommended by MWE-SW11-S4P-001. title: SWING11_S4P_OPTION_B_PROSPECTIVE_ARCHIVAL_AUTHORIZATION_V1
decision: Authorize Option B prospectively for the SAME MWE-SW11-S4P-001 after verified Option A source certification failed to establish sufficient historical point-in-time earnings and historical short locate/availability/fee/recall evidence for the existing development envelope. Authorize outcome-blind design and implementation of a zero-incremental-cost prospective as-known archival/source path for earnings and short implementation evidence, together with a prospectively separated future S4 development boundary and independent S5 reservation. This authorization does not itself freeze calendar dates or sample lengths: S4P must recommend the exact collection start, minimum coverage/maturity criteria, S4 development interval, S5 protected reservation, contamination controls, and transition rules before any future price bars or S4 outcomes are opened; any consequential boundary choice not deterministically implied by existing authority must return for canonical approval. Preserve the frozen S4-TIME-5/7/10 design and modeled cost framework. Do not weaken the no-earnings or short-availability fail-closed gates. No paid provider upgrade, paid data, paid compute, S4 real outcome exposure, protected validation, S5/S6 execution, deployment, new predictors/mechanisms, RV20 reintroduction, or post-outcome methodology changes are authorized. ZERO_INCREMENTAL_COST_FIRST remains mandatory.
evidence: User explicitly approved Option B in canonical Indicator: Swing Trades after reviewing the verified Option A blocker handoff. MWE-SW11-S4P-001 UUID 9ddaa698-f607-4b86-b145-6bb0d762d34d remains outcome-blind and resumable. Option A handoff reports no new S4 outcomes and protected validation unopened.
rationale: Option A was technically successful but certified zero complete PIT earnings coverage and zero complete historical locate/availability/recall coverage for the existing 112-symbol by 394-session development envelope. Prospective archival is therefore authorized rather than fabricating historical knowledge or weakening practical gates. Exact future development and validation boundaries must be frozen prospectively before future bars are opened.
